node.dcterms:title: RobOS Home Speaker
node.dcterms:description: Smart speaker intercom, walkie-talkie voice notes, neural TTS broadcast, custom audio streaming, and soundboard controller for Google Home, Nest, and Cast devices.

node.dcterms:title: RobOS GNOME Desktop App Installer
node.dcterms:description: Manage GNOME desktop shortcuts, App Grid .desktop launchers, GIO trusted desktop icons, multi-scale hicolor icons, and GNOME Dock favorites across all RobOS applications.

node.dcterms:title: RobOS VPN Sandbox
node.dcterms:description: Zero-leak OpenVPN application launcher that runs any desktop or CLI executable inside an isolated Linux network namespace (ip netns) with a 3-barrier iptables/ip6tables kill-switch so your normal public IP is never exposed.

node.dcterms:title: RobOS VPN Servers
node.dcterms:description: Manage OpenVPN providers (IPVanish built-in with 3,598 server profiles), GPG/AES-256-GCM encrypted VPN accounts, live TLS 1.3 credential verification, and server locations across RobOS.

node.dcterms:title: RobOS App Mesh
node.dcterms:description: Provider-agnostic Zero-Trust App & IPC Port Mesh that securely bridges RobOS application IPC/snapshot ports (19100–19231) and service ports (:3410, :19210, :19213, :63343) across machines on the same or different networks using built-in Mutual TLS 1.3 peer pinning, OpenZiti, Tailscale/Headscale, NetBird, or WireGuard.
node.robos:technology: Electron 28 / Mutual TLS 1.3 / OpenZiti / Tailscale / NetBird / WireGuard

node.dcterms:title: RobOS Smart TV Studio
node.dcterms:description: First-class Smart TV integration studio: LAN TV discovery, Developer Mode native package generator & sideloader (LG webOS IPK, Samsung Tizen WGT, Google TV/Android TV ADB Leanback, Roku OS), automated LG 1,000-hour dev timer renewal, 10-foot D-Pad/Gamepad Big-Screen Portal (:19210), and Moonlight/Sunshine 4K 120Hz streaming.
node.robos:technology: Electron 28 / Smart TV Developer Mode / 10-Foot Spatial Navigation Portal

node.dcterms:title: RobOS Party Game
node.dcterms:description: First game in the Party Games category: an animated AI host face runs survey-powered mini games on one or more RobOS TVs (stage, scoreboard and spotlight screens) while guests play on their phones. Guests get roles from their answers, the party host describes the house, and the required AI agent writes the show (role reveals, superlatives, interest trivia, House Quests using the real rooms and supplies, bluffs, recaps and finale awards). Mini games share a reusable template.
node.robos:technology: Electron 28 / LAN HTTP + SSE / RobOS TV app casts / robos-agent-client

node.dcterms:title: RobOS Hardware Keys
node.dcterms:description: Physical YubiKey & FIDO2/U2F push-key security studio: live USB/HID/CTAP2 hardware inspector, interactive physical touch assertion verifier, hardware-backed OpenSSH keys (ed25519-sk & ecdsa-sk), FIDO2 PIN & resident passkeys manager, Linux PAM U2F enrollment (pamu2fcfg), and RobOS Pass Store / Agent touch-to-approve security gates.
node.robos:technology: Electron 30 / YubiKey Manager (ykman) / CTAP2 / OpenSSH FIDO2 (-sk) / PAM U2F
